pymilvus/client/entity_helper.py line:228
Low ---- This fast path returns a `str` value under UTF-8 without running the max-length check requested by `check=True` for VARCHAR/GEOMETRY. The old per-character loop also never validated the total string length (each iteration saw a single character), so the effective behavior is unchanged, but `CHECK_STR_ARRAY` is now silently skipped on the common row path. Is dropping client-side length validation for row-mode values intentional, or should `len(value)` be checked once against the field's max length here?

Not intentional, and no validation is lost: before this change `convert_to_str_array` received the whole string and iterated it, so the `max_length` check ran against each single character (always length 1) and never against the full value. A row-mode VARCHAR/GEOMETRY value was therefore never length-checked client-side; the server-side limit is what rejects oversized values, and that still applies.

I kept this PR to the performance fix so behaviour stays identical. Adding a one-time `len(value)` check against `max_length` here would be new validation (and would change which error users see), so I'd rather do it separately if you want it. Happy to add it to this PR if you prefer.
